capabilities: Search snippets by keyword, language, and tag
extras: Local-first design; no cloud sync, telemetry, or remote API usage.
intentEvidence: code-snippet-manager is a Markdown-first code snippet manager for Obsidian.
problem: Users need a way to manage and reuse code snippets within Markdown files without relying on external databases or dedicated snippet tools.
summary: A Markdown-first code snippet manager that allows users to collect, organize, search, and insert reusable code snippets directly into their vault.
